How to read these results
Ratios use sRGB relative luminance and the WCAG contrast formula, computed from the actual primitive/semantic hex values in the iOS foundation files. Normal text is compared against 4.5:1. Large text uses 3:1 when it qualifies. Necessary non-text indicators and boundaries use 3:1 against adjacent colours. Decorative or redundant graphics require contextual assessment. This is a pair comparison, not a whole-component accessibility certification.
W3C: text contrast · W3C: non-text contrast

Review shortlist

Shortlisting records a preference for discussion. It does not approve a token, change the skills or update either app.

Source: active iOS foundation token values and colour primitives. Candidate samples are isolated from the canonical token catalogue and agent defaults. Icon-container dimensions shown here are illustrative, not approved geometry. No app, Android, builder or Figma changes.
